gap_register.label: G01
gap_register.title: Authority, fixture identity and public API differ
gap_register.required: Closed launch_authority/plan v2; stage RUN-QA identities; exact task/queue/readiness/governance projection; source-v3 public lock CLI.
gap_register.observed: Foreign v3 admits only TASK-20260909-3d02f7, fixed DEC8ccd1a/priorDEC7db063 authority namespace and plan v1 with real RUN-ECDLP identifiers in disposable roots. Entries have only --launch-context-fd; outer flags are --expected-sha256/--authority. Foreign lowercase predicates do not implement frozen uppercase error codes.
gap_register.next: Freeze field-by-field authority/identity/CLI/error-code translation in one new nonoverlapping contract; no use of foreign claim as c9 authority.

gap_register.label: G02
gap_register.title: Separate canonical runner receipt is absent
gap_register.required: 16/18 original-plus-six profiles and standalone runner_receipt v1, actual records/ledger/schema coupled consumers with three exact prospective schema deltas.
gap_register.observed: Foreign15/17 profiles deliberately embed launch_receipt in raw-result, omit runner-receipt.json and disclaim canonical standalone receipt compliance. v3 validates local approval/plan and manifest with JSON Schema, not an actual canonical receipt/records/ledger pair.
gap_register.next: Freeze compatible receipt/output extension and consumer policy; retain every receipt/manifest mutation and16/18profile requirement.

gap_register.label: G03
gap_register.title: Private result protocol and public entry wiring differ
gap_register.required: Closed bounded finite result report over private FD, instrument/control/failure semantics, source-v3 public lock CLI and protected forwarding.
gap_register.observed: Process passes only context FD; worker prints a sentinel and returns exit status. Parent collects no private result report. Source-v4 main is private-context only; scientific forwarding is deliberately unreachable. Missing/invalid report cases have no corresponding mechanism.
gap_register.next: Add only missing public/private bridge and bounded result channel after complete source-bound approval; science stays unauthorized.

gap_register.label: G04
gap_register.title: Native grammar and harmless metadata handling differ
gap_register.required: Separate controller/producer, bound task/role/policy/model/provider/effort, truthful unprobed fields and routing-only provider scan.
gap_register.observed: Foreign code separates parent_thread_id/thread_id and checks referenced claim/probe. It scans entire native/reference canonical text for prohibited marker and requires serving provider/model/effort null when unprobed. Required fieldset differs from canonical task/role projection; harmless annotation positive is not compatible.
gap_register.next: Freeze truthful raw-plus-normalized provenance and exact scan boundary; retain each task/role/session/policy/model/effort/probe mutation.

gap_register.label: G05
gap_register.title: Inventory closure does not provide a dynamic pre-body import guard
gap_register.required: Complete runtime/project origin guards before module bodies; undeclared import and poisoned-cache refusal; source-closure artifact.
gap_register.observed: Source binds mandatory files, installed distributions/stdlib and mapped images, then compares origins after loading YAML/JSON Schema/core. Entry loads adapter and adapter loads helper before context validation. No dynamic import guard appears in inspected adapter/process/worker. -B alone does not prevent cache reads.
gap_register.next: Reuse hashed inventories; define trusted bootstrap and pre-body loader checks, then execute exact unknown-import/bytecode controls under a new contract.

gap_register.label: G06
gap_register.title: Strict parser lacks the frozen document bounds
gap_register.required: 16MiB maximum documents, depth64/node100000 caps, reject anchors/aliases/merge/custom tags and exact duplicate/nonstring/nonfinite/type cases.
gap_register.observed: strict_json rejects duplicate/nonfinite tokens and exact_integer refuses bool. YAML explicitly rejects AliasEvent and duplicate/nonstring keys. read_regular consumes entire file without16MiB bound; no explicit depth/node counters or anchor-only rejection appears. Exact error code API differs.
gap_register.next: Retain parser primitives but freeze missing size/depth/node/anchor checks and code mapping; execute all schema-field and parse subvariants through normal admission.

gap_register.label: G07
gap_register.title: Terminal precedence, missing output and zero RSS differ
gap_register.required: Integrity dominates terminal status while raw child causes survive; missing report/artifact -> failed_implementation; unsupported zero/unavailable required RSS prevents valid.
gap_register.observed: Foreign classify retains resource_exhaustion/failed_implementation terminal status with postflight failures; successful child with incomplete output becomes completed_invalid. It has no valid gate for supported positive RSS. Memory classification uses stderr markers. Output alias/membership feed output_ok rather than integrity. This is source comparison, no admitted bypass.
gap_register.next: Freeze coupled final status and retained child-cause policy; keep exact mixed-cause, missing-report/output, zero-RSS and alias expected outcomes.

gap_register.label: G08
gap_register.title: Watchdog and resource fixture contracts differ

Foreign fixture default128MiB/30s and memory24MiB/64MiB ceiling differ; success worker lacks required8MiB/0.2s observability. Mechanisms are candidates, not equivalent controls.
gap_register.next: Retain DECd0 bounds unless an explicit additive policy resolves each difference. Implement true null support or explicitly approved future watchdog without relabeling old nulls.

gap_register.label: G09

original_findings.title: Required execution_approval v1 interface and source/plan authority are absent
original_findings.archived_requirement: engineering_successor.lock_compatibility retains execution_approval and fields approved_base_commit, specification_sha256, execution_plan_sha256, protocol_hashes, python, resource_policy, allowed_verifier_transitions; sidecar plan is hash-bound.
archived_observations: Schema requires finite_yaml_lock, has additionalProperties:false, and contains no execution_approval envelope or approved_base_commit, execution_plan_sha256, allowed_verifier_transitions fields.

validate_lock accepts a syntactically shaped disposable self-constructed metadata fixture after only an external matching digest and partial claim comparison; there is no committed plan/approval/claim-file verification in this interface.
This differs from the frozen contract even though all integration bytes are correctly archived. A future real lock would require engineering changes, not only filling prospective values.
original_findings.disposition: retained_original_failure_no_retroactive_PASS; candidate implementation support and unresolved contract/evidence gaps require additive convergence and independent QA

original_findings.title: Reserved configuration membership is not checked and source-v2 entries are not wired launch interfaces
original_findings.archived_requirement: Exact two-cell/five-case mapping must be accepted only with its own specification/configuration and verified pre-import launch; additive wrappers must integrate the immutable kernels.
archived_observations: All seven reserved RUN IDs were accepted by validate_lock when paired with the correct original specification hash but deliberately wrong cell or six-field configuration in argv. These were validation-only calls; no reserved run directory or kernel was invoked.
EXP-ECDLP-abf981 paired with incidence RUN-ECDLP-3c6277 was also accepted. The adapter checks identifier shape/equality only.

Both source-v2 wrapper files invoked with a nonexistent lock return exit 0 and no output: neither has argument parsing or a main dispatcher. Their callable bodies invoke _import_archived_kernel before any launch validation. Static source review finds no validate_lock/execute_locked call and no verified token argument.
The twelve-case static metadata helper is separate from run_locked_case and is not called during its forwarding call. No scientific forwarding call was performed in QA.
original_findings.disposition: retained_original_failure_no_retroactive_PASS; candidate implementation support and unresolved contract/evidence gaps require additive convergence and independent QA

original_findings.title: Claim and native provenance checks do not enforce the complete bound authority
original_findings.archived_requirement: Exact live task/claim/owner/epoch/expiry and real native receipt must be bound; no Bedrock, fallback/degradation, or unprobed model_verified promotion.
archived_observations: Mismatched branch and session, an expired lock reference paired with a fresh caller claim, a caller claim acquired in 2099, a mismatched receipt session, and a wrong metric-decision hash all passed admission.

A native receipt containing provider BEDROCK passed admission. A prohibited marker in the separate caller authority was correctly refused. The provider test was metadata only; no network/model call occurred.
model_verified:true with adapter_probe_performed:false and fallback/degradation with low effort passed admission.
Every observed generated manifest omitted native_launch_receipt entirely. The separate engineering author report does not discharge the adapter launch-provenance requirement.
original_findings.disposition: retained_original_failure_no_retroactive_PASS; candidate implementation support and unresolved contract/evidence gaps require additive convergence and independent QA

original_findings.title: Executable, import closure and environment declarations are not enforced
original_findings.archived_requirement: Complete imported source closure, actual executable path/version/hash, dependency pins and environment allowlist must be bound.
archived_observations: The declared executable hash can be correct while argv[0] names a different nonexistent executable; validation accepted it. An invented executable version was accepted.
A source_closure containing only the benign child-config JSON was accepted despite omitting the executed program, adapter, core runner, records, budget module and PyYAML dependency.
environment_allowlist:[] did not prevent a benign child from observing the deliberately supplied FINITE_YAML_QA_CANARY environment variable. Only this synthetic canary was tested; no secret was read.
The emitted environment companion contains dependencies:{} and a fixed selected_environment list, rather than binding the lock allowlist or relevant dependency versions/hashes.
original_findings.disposition: retained_original_failure_no_retroactive_PASS; candidate implementation support and unresolved contract/evidence gaps require additive convergence and independent QA

original_findings.title: Launch-time revalidation and independent postflight bindings are missing
original_findings.archived_requirement: Protocol/claim/lock/source drift must refuse before scientific import; postflight must check raw specification, lock, source closure and approved commit/tree state.
archived_observations: After normal validate_lock, modifying the benign child source, the synthetic lock or the synthetic specification still allowed execute_locked to launch the child and create output.

A claim that was valid during validate_lock expired naturally before execute_locked; the benign child still entered. This control used the real clock and did not mutate the VerifiedLaunch or bypass admission.
The frozen dataclass contains mutable argv/dict members; a separately labeled mutation control altered the accepted authority expiry and it was used without revalidation.

For postlaunch lock and specification mutation, source_closure_unchanged stayed true because these files are not automatically included in protocol_files. Manifest checks contain neither approval_lock_unchanged nor specification_unchanged nor commit_unchanged.

Uncommitted reviewer scratch caused tree_unchanged_except_run_dir:false for baseline and attack cases, so actual terminal manifests remained failed_infrastructure. This confound was preserved; QA did not bypass the tree check or observe completed_valid under drift.
archived_limitations: No actual completed_valid bypass was demonstrated. Missing postflight checks are established by source plus per-check diagnostics; clean-tree end-to-end validity remains untested.
original_findings.disposition: retained_original_failure_no_retroactive_PASS; candidate implementation support and unresolved contract/evidence gaps require additive convergence and independent QA

original_findings.title: Output allowlist and no-clobber protections fail for child artifacts
original_findings.archived_requirement: Exact output allowlist, no symlink/hardlink aliases, full hashing, exclusive manifest-last/fsync and partial preservation are required.
archived_observations: A child-created raw-result.json symlink to a scratch-only protected sentinel caused the parent adapter to overwrite that target with its raw result. A hardlink fixture caused the same overwrite. Both targets and post-write bytes are retained.

original_findings.archived_requirement: Demonstrate low synthetic memory/watchdog/worker enforcement, process group quiescence, and truthful operational failure classification; schema version/type errors must refuse.
archived_observations: Normal admission and execution on non-root macOS demonstrated a 24 MiB RSS limit killing a benign allocator (peak 25755648 bytes, memory_killed:true, return_code:-9), a 0.4 second watchdog kill (wall 0.518397375009954 seconds), and fork refusal (errno 35). These are platform-specific operational measurements.

All postflight manifest statuses were overwritten by the independent dirty-tree failure, so success/failure/resource terminal-classification end-to-end validity is incomplete even though raw outcomes are preserved.
A separately labeled deterministic metadata test with return_code:0 and group_quiescent:false produced (completed_valid,true,None) from _classify. No real nonquiescent child was launched.

format_version:true and maximum_workers:true passed admission because const/equality comparisons accept Python boolean/integer equality. Zero timeout was accepted. The schema forbids null watchdog, so any incidence successor needs a separately justified finite process watchdog or a contract-preserving null path.
Three short actual processes produced peak_rss_bytes:0 despite executing the Python child, exposing a sampling-resolution limit. QA does not turn zero sampling into proof of zero memory.
